items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed out Week 7; 49ers D conceding RB catches lately (White, Holani, Harvey, Love) and inflates opposing RB prod 4.4% (7th-most). Sweet setup for Bijan.
items.why: Hamstring; official OUT. 49ers pass-catching RB vulnerability + DvP data.
items.implication: Bijan full workload upside vs soft RB matchup.
items.opportunity: Extra carries + receiving work with no clear backup on roster.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) will not practice Friday, listed questionable; McVay says felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame. Injury believed minor.
items.why: Exited Thursday practice early with calf; DNP Friday; minor per reports but power lacking.
items.implication: Game-time decision vs Raiders; if out, heavy TE/WR committee usage.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets for Higbee/Parkinson/Atwell etc.

items.text: Bears placing TE Cole Kmet on IR due to serious knee injury suffered Thursday night; season-ending per coach Ben Johnson.
items.why: Carted off non-contact knee injury Thursday vs Patriots; confirmed season-ending by coach.
items.implication: Opens TE and WR route opportunities in Bears offense with Caleb Williams.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for remaining TEs and WRs in 11/12 personnel.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.why: Groin injury; official ruling by HC.
items.implication: Colts TE/ receiving void; check backups for volume.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go Sunday, Stafford looking at Tyler Higbee, Konata Mumpfield, Colby Parkinson, Tutu Atwell, Jordan Whittington, Davis Allen.
items.why: Adams already IR; Nacua absence would force heavy TE and depth WR usage in McVay scheme.
items.implication: Higbee primary short-term TE target spike; stash depth WRs.
items.opportunity: TE target share historically high (37%) without Nacua previously.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK; since Caleb Williams’ return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR PPG, 6+ receptions and 60+ yards in both games.
items.why: Elevated role and production tied directly to Williams return; now further boosted by Kmet IR.
items.implication: Strong TE1/ streamer with clear target share and efficiency.
items.opportunity: 30% target share, high route involvement post-Williams.

items.text: Lamar Jackson: 'Right now, I'm headed in the right direction.' Dealing with high ankle sprain; could be game-time decision vs Bengals after limited practices.
items.why: Missed two games; practicing limited, positive self-report on high ankle.
items.implication: Boost to Ravens pass catchers if active; monitor pregame.
items.opportunity: Full offense unlock for Flowers/Andrews if plays.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle sprain) ruled out again this week by coach Mike LaFleur.
items.why: Still recovering from high-ankle; coach ruling.
items.implication: Continued absence opens ARI RB committee or other usage.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played on just 21% of the snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.why: Sharp drop in playing time last three weeks amid ankle/ fumbling concerns.
items.implication: Unreliable for fantasy starts; role shrinking behind Stevenson/others.
items.opportunity: Low snap share limits ceiling despite talent.

items.text: Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet injury may reduce 2-/3-TE sets giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; structural change from Kmet IR favors more WR sets.
items.implication: Increased opportunity and upside as primary beneficiary alongside Loveland.
items.opportunity: Higher route rate potential, already elite YPRR.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday because he's awesome, the scheme is awesome, and the 49ers' entire WR corps is hurt—not because of National Tight Ends Day (no historical fantasy bump).
items.why: WR corps injuries force target funnel to Kittle in Shanahan scheme.
items.implication: Elite TE1 ceiling this week regardless of holiday narrative.
items.opportunity: Massive target/route share with Evans/Samuel etc. limited.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical at facility (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers—both poor; OL mess too. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS show.
items.why: Facility access positive sign; backups inefficient per EPA data.
items.implication: Jacobs return timeline improving; handcuffs not producing well.
items.opportunity: Potential full workload reclaim on return given backup inefficiency.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups. Also loves AJ Brown, DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft, Jordan Love, Goff, Stroud.
items.why: Volume + soft defenses allowing RB production; pass-catchers get Bears/Lions gifts and role confirmation.
items.implication: Start with confidence in PPR/ standard.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares projected in good spots.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU, Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA due to matchups/roles/volume concerns.
items.why: Nasty matchups, uncertain post-injury roles, or low target shares on struggling offenses.
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats this week.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility access and poor backup EPA as longer-term positive.
